**What you are taking:** class name(s) or function family, and the slots or addresses
(from `python tools/fn.py unmatched --class ...`).

**Source file you will work in:** for example `src/gameplay/ActionEvents.cpp`.

**AI-assisted?** yes / no

Close the claim, or say so here, if you stop working on it.
